description: This file contains implementation of secure system call wrappers, including functions for executing commands, handling process I/O, and managing file descriptors, primarily used for testing or stub purposes within the project.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Executes a command string with arguments, parsing and handling subprocesses, pipes, and redirections.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Creates a pipe to a subprocess for reading or writing, wrapping internal command parsing and process management.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by v_secure_popen and waits for the subprocess to terminate.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: Executes a command with argument array, forking and waiting for process completion.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: Executes a command with variable arguments, forking and waiting for process completion.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Stub function returning -1, placeholder for security separator check.
